name: Anemone Bile
body:
Price 200 gp

ABOUT

This amphetamine-based revival drug which will reverse the effects of many other drugs and conditions, but will send the victim into near berserk fits.

DETAILS

Type poison (injury); Save Fortitude DC 15 Onset 1 minute; Frequency once; Cure 1 save

EFFECT

Reverses unconsciousness and paralysis, but causes victim to be confused and sickened for 1d10 minutes
